pages.description: Owner-managed tented camp in the Lolldaiga Hills conservancy, Laikipia, and a private beach house on Kizingoni Beach, Lamu Island. Lion, leopard, cheetah, elephant, Grevy
pages.text:
Kenya Safari Camp & Beach House | Lolldaiga Hills, Mt. Kenya & Lamu | The Safari Series
0
The Safari Series is a collection of small, family-owned, conservation-focused properties in Kenya - Moon's Camp in Lolldaiga Hills conservancy in Laikipia, Chuchungi House, a private beach house, on Lamu Island. A third property, Ontulili Camp, a walking camp on the slopes of Mt. Kenya, is coming soon.
We are passion about showing our guests the best of these incredible natural landscapes, while welcoming you as friends, to our home….
